name: Dorcas Gabriels
bio: Dorcas Gabriels serves as Vice President, Chief Operating Officer, and Secretary of Hephzibah Delight Global Mission. She provides operational and administrative leadership, supporting organizational development, program coordination, and effective resource management.

She brings over 10 years of professional experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, supply chain management, vendor relations, and operational improvement. She holds a Master of Business Administration in Supply Chain Management from Arkansas State University and a Bachelor of Science in Economics from Bridgewater State University.
Dorcas is passionate about strengthening organizational operations, building effective partnerships, and ensuring that humanitarian initiatives are delivered efficiently and responsibly.
